prediction_text: Yes — he shall purchase Master B.'s houses and shall deal with the seller successfully, and the money will be procured in time, though not without delay and working for it. The Sun, the seller's significator, in the 7th received by Venus in exaltation, and the lord of the 7th being also lord of the 11th (his hopes), show the seller well-disposed and the bargain tending to his hope; Venus applying to a trine of Saturn, lord of the 4th, perfects the matter of the houses. Mercury, lord of his 2nd, retrograde, says his own money cannot be called in at once (the six months' delay in the question), so payment is made by degrees and the seller must wait part of the time; the first price of £530 will be abated. Timing: month-scale — the purchase concluded within the following months, money completed by instalments rather than at one payment.
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary。已载面：能否与卖家成交（主问）、钱能否及时筹足（题面自载六个月不能回收自有资金）、首价£530。断项过闸：成交←卖家象征太阳在七宫得金星擢升接纳＋七宫主兼十一宫主（希望）；成屋←金星三合四宫主土星；钱迟而终足←二宫主水星逆行（迟滞非断绝）；应期定月档（交易进程），三路候选以象征星成相进程取月尺度主坐标，不落单日。对象核：承受=求问者本人，应验同一。盘面上升点原文 OCR 残损，已注明、只据所载位置作断。
